Maya Chen: Heads-up — thinking about a tiny UX shift for Console Analytics: let users pin 'dashlets' (small per-route/per-model widgets) and also persist filters per dashlet instead of page-level. Thoughts?
Evan Brooks: +1. Main concern: saved filter proliferation. We need a lightweight foldering or auto-cleanup.
Priya Nadar: What about permissioning? Teams want shared dashlets for org-level vs personal. Suggest scopes: personal, team, org.
Sahil Gupta: Implementation note: saved filters currently reference query id. If we allow dashlet-level persist, we must extend saved_query model to include dashlet_id and visibility enum.
Jesse: Could we leverage existing saved views? Reuse API: /api/v1/queries/{id}/apply and add ?dashlet=... so minimal backend work.
Priya Nadar: Also need export CSV for dashlet. Product asked for quick export to share w/ analytics.
console-bot: Deploy notice: Feature flags exist: analytics_dashlets_v1 ON in staging.
Maya Chen: UX: default landing — prefer to allow teams to set route-level default dashboard. Whether pinned personal dashlets show to others depends on scope.
Evan Brooks: Edge case: when model flavor changes (quantized vs fp16) metrics vary. Dashlets should allow model-version filter and fall back gracefully.
Sahil Gupta: Backend: suggest canonical id shape 'savedquery:dashlet:<uuid>' and a TTL for personal items older than 6 months.
Priya Nadar: For discoverability, add 'Suggested for you' in add-dashlet modal, using route access frequency.
Jesse: TL;DR: Agree on scopes (personal/team/org), reuse saved query endpoints, small model-version semantics, add CSV export. I'll mock API contract tomorrow.
Maya Chen: Perfect. @Evan can you do a quick mock of the UI (2 variants: compact vs card) by EOD? We'll sync on Friday. :calendar:
Evan Brooks: Yep — I'll post Figma links when ready. :thumbsup:
